LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_ReachedCrew: The fire on the {VEHICLE} has reached the crew compartment.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_UseDesc: Someone aboard turns the extinguisher on the fire, or, with nobody aboard, the nearest free colonist runs to use it: it knocks the fire down, and puts a small one out. To choose who goes, select a colonist and right-click the vehicle. {LEFT} of {FULL} charges left; a mechanic refills it at the vehicle.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_Empty: The {VEHICLE}'s extinguisher is empty: a mechanic refills it with an extinguisher refill.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_NobodyFree: Nobody aboard the {VEHICLE} can use it, and no colonist is free to reach it.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_Sent: {PAWN} is going to fight the fire on the {VEHICLE} with its extinguisher.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_Menu: Fight the fire on the {VEHICLE} with its extinguisher
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_MenuCannot: Cannot fight the fire on the {VEHICLE}: {REASON}
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_UsedOut: {PAWN} put out the fire on the {VEHICLE} with its extinguisher. {LEFT} charges left.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_UsedDown: {PAWN} knocked the fire on the {VEHICLE} down with its extinguisher, but it still burns. {LEFT} charges left.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_SuppressedOut: The {VEHICLE}'s fire suppression went off in the {ZONE} and put the fire out. It is spent until recharged.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_SuppressedPart: The {VEHICLE}'s fire suppression put out the fire in the {ZONE}, but the vehicle still burns elsewhere. It is spent until recharged.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_Recharged: {MECHANIC} recharged the {VEHICLE}'s {PART}. It is ready again.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_SpentIntro: These vehicles' fire protection has been used up. A mechanic recharges a suppression system with a suppressant bottle and refills an extinguisher with an extinguisher refill, both made at the vehicle parts bench.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SendNobody: No colonist is free to reach the {VEHICLE} and do it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_JumpStartButtonDesc: Its battery is too low to start it. Sends the nearest free colonist with a way to jump-start it: a vehicle near, jump leads or a booster pack. To choose who, select a colonist and right-click the vehicle.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_TankPurgeButtonDesc: The empty tank still holds the last of its {CONTENTS}. Sends the nearest free colonist to wash it out. To choose who, select a colonist and right-click the vehicle.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ClaimButtonDesc: Nobody is aboard and none of its people stand near. Sends the nearest free colonist to work on it and make it ours. To choose who, select a colonist and right-click the vehicle.
LanguageData.PhobosFireFighting_LeakCaught: Fuel leaking from {VEHICLE} has caught: fire is spreading on the ground beneath it.
